title: PR/memlog claim '117/119 T2 PNGs pixel-identical' misstates the committed T2 golden set (113 PNGs)
evidence: pr96-body.md lines 48-50: "change. Proven: 117/119 T2 PNGs **pixel-identical** before/after the / re-bless; all 49 `.log.bin` differ ONLY in the 8 catalog-hash header bytes". The chunk contains exactly two PNG changes: "diff --git a/goldens/dublin_board/30000ms.png b/goldens/dublin_board/30000ms.png / index ... / Binary files a/goldens/dublin_board/30000ms.png and b/goldens/dublin_board/30000ms.png differ" and the identical stub for 90000ms.png. Counting the tree at both SHAs (read-only verification in the worktree): `git ls-tree -r 044a6d2^ --name-only | grep -c 'goldens/.*\.png'` = 113 and `git ls-tree -r 044a6d2 --name-only | grep -c 'goldens/.*\.png'` = 113 (also `find goldens -name '*.png' | wc -l` = 113 at the reviewed sha). The .t1 (51) and .log.bin (49) counts in the same claim DO match the tree exactly.
detail: The committed T2 set is 113 PNGs (111 unchanged + 2 re-blessed), not 119/117. No golden was missed, but the determinism audit trail overstates the verified scope by six captures.
recommended_fix: Correct the PR body + memlog counts to 111/113 (or state what the extra 6 counted); the byte-level evidence itself is sound.

title: Spawn-audit header line mislabels node_count (terminals + routers) as 'live terminals', contradicting the audit's own count
evidence: harness/dublin_shot.odin:195: `fmt.printfln("dublin-grown: %d ticks played, %d live terminals", ticks, pp.node_count(&state.topology))`. core/topology.odin:76-79: `node_count :: proc(t: ^Topology) -> int { n := 0 for alive in t.node_alive { if alive { n += 1 } } return n }` — every live node, any kind. The committed gate evidence docs/captures/v2-dublin-spawn-director/spawn-audit.txt line 1: "dublin-grown: 1800 ticks played, 17 live terminals" vs its own line 16 (terminal-only count): "dublin-grown: 15 live terminals across 52 districts". The demo places 2 routers (demos/dublin_board.dem: "two high routers"), so 17 = 15 terminals + 2 routers; the PR body and audit read "15 grown terminals".
detail: The gate artifact's first line says 17 'live terminals' while its own terminal scan says 15 — the label counts routers too. A future gate reader re-running the audit will see 17 vs the canon's 15 and question the evidence.
recommended_fix: In dublin_shot.odin, count `node_kind == .Terminal` for the header line (as the audit loop below already does), or relabel it 'live nodes'; re-record spawn-audit.txt.
